name: @loomhelm/multi-task-flow
description: Versioned Bun CLI and complete Multi-task Flow Skill runtime for Loomhelm

scripts.test: bun run build && bun test test/*.test.ts
scripts.pack:check: bun run build && bun pm pack --dry-run
scripts.publish:exact: bun --no-install src/cli.ts release validate --version "$npm_package_version" && bun pm publish
scripts.publish:compat: bun --no-install src/cli.ts release validate --version "$npm_package_version" --dist-tag "compat-v${npm_config_compat_version:-1}" && bun pm publish --tag "compat-v${npm_config_compat_version:-1}"
